newsitem.title: USA: NY gunman kills self, ex-girlfriend in hostage drama.
newsitem.headline: NY gunman kills self, ex-girlfriend in hostage drama.

text.p: A gunman shot and killed himself and his pregnant, teenage former girlfriend Monday after taking hostages and waging a standoff with police for several hours, authorities said.
Three hostages also were shot and wounded, police said.
The standoff began about 7:30 a.m. in the borough of Brooklyn, when James Parker, 24, arrived at his former girlfriend's apartment, began firing a gun and took the 10 occupants captive, police said.
Some of the hostages were children, said police, who arrived and began negotiating with the gunman.

At about 11 a.m. the woman, identified as Danielle DiMedici, 17, began shouting to police, "You must get in here because he's going to kill everybody," said Deputy Police Commissioner Tosano Simonetti.
Police broke through the apartment door, firing flares through the windows and roof skylight in an effort to distract the gunman, authorities said.
As police entered, the gunman shot DiMedici and himself in the head. He was dead at the scene and she was pronounced dead on arrival at a local hospital, police said.
She was seven months pregnant, they said.
The other shooting victims included her grandmother, who was shot in the head, a man who was shot in the chest and another woman who was shot in the leg, police said.
All three, who were either friend or relatives of DiMedici, were being treated at local hospitals, police said.

Parker had been wanted by police for allegedly kidnapping DiMedici late last month and holding her captive for two days before she escaped, authorities said. He also was arrested in July for allegedly assaulting her with a baseball bat, police said.

She had obtained a court order of protection against him and carried an electronic beeper for alerting police if he approached her, authorities said. It was unclear if she was carrying the beeper on Monday, police said.
